evidence.detail: The enum preserves exactly OFF, ON and ADAPTIVE.
The SpawnPK GPU settings holder owns this enum as its synchronization mode, and R87 GpuRenderer switches over its ordinal to derive the active frame/swap synchronization behavior.
RuneLite GpuPluginConfig preserves a nested enum literally named SyncMode with the identical OFF, ON and ADAPTIVE constants, consumed by the GPU plugin's vsync configuration.

proposals.note: SyncMode is corroborated by exact-v308 enum values/consumers and a matching RuneLite GPU identifier. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exactly DISABLED, MSAA_2, MSAA_4, MSAA_8 and MSAA_16, with display strings Disabled / MSAA x2 / x4 / x8 / x16 and sample counts 0 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16.
The enum stores one display String and one int sample count; toString() returns the display label and a() returns the sample count.

The SpawnPK GPU settings holder defaults to DISABLED, while R87 GpuRenderer consumes the selected enum, compares against DISABLED, calls its sample-count accessor, clamps against GL_MAX_SAMPLES and logs the surviving diagnostic "AA samples: {}, max samples: {}, forced samples: {}".
RuneLite preserves net.runelite.client.plugins.gpu.config.AntiAliasingMode with the same constants, display strings, sample counts, toString behavior and samples accessor.

proposals.note: AntiAliasingMode is corroborated by exact-v308 enum values/consumers and a matching RuneLite GPU identifier. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exactly NONE, PROTANOPE, DEUTERANOPE and TRITANOPE.

The SpawnPK GPU settings holder defaults to the first value and R87 GpuRenderer sends the selected enum ordinal to its color-blindness shader uniform in both the primary draw path and related GPU program setup.
RuneLite preserves net.runelite.client.plugins.gpu.config.ColorBlindMode with the identical NONE / PROTANOPE / DEUTERANOPE / TRITANOPE enum surface and the GPU config exposes it as colorBlindMode.

proposals.note: ColorBlindMode is corroborated by exact-v308 enum values/consumers and a matching RuneLite GPU identifier. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.
